name: FA complementation group L

function.text: FANCL encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase FANCL. Annotated molecular activities include ubiquitin-protein transferase activity and ubiquitin protein ligase activity. It participates in DNA repair and protein monoubiquitination.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Fanconi anemia complementation group L (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
